newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin rises further on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin rises further on foreign demand.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rose six cents to close at 13.90 ringgit ($5.24) a kg with foreign demand and gains in London Metal Exchange boosting sentiment, traders said.

"The market was firm. If demand continues and London keeps rising then we will see the market reach the 14 ringgit level," a trader said. Turnover was 135 tonnes, against 78 on Friday, with buying mainly from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
The local premium over London was at a $5 a tonne discount against a premium of $20 last Friday.
